listing.name: Nightmare Creatures II / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build a native Nightmare Creatures II player from your matching original PlayStation disc and BIOS.

steps.title: Use the exact original files
steps.instruction: Use your own Nightmare Creatures II (USA) disc (SLUS-01112) with all 2 tracks and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Set up the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select the complete matching CHD and BIOS. Keep both original files in place. Portcove builds the player with its registered toolchain. Choose Play after the build finishes.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac copy
steps.instruction: Extract the official v0.1.0 ZIP for Intel or Apple silicon. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. The Mac setup host and bundled generators require macOS 11 or newer.

steps.title: Build and add the completed Mac player
steps.instruction: Run Nightmare_Creatures_II from the kit folder and choose Generate & rebuild. Keep the CUE and every referenced BIN together if using CUE/BIN. In Portcove, select build-release/Nightmare_Creatures_II as the player and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Portcove checks the first data track and track count. Keep the complete disc intact.
Mac setup, replacement and backups belong to you and the upstream kit. Native setup, gameplay and populated-save behavior remain unverified.

references.title: Keep the original files and your data
references.instruction: Keep your disc and BIOS separately. For a Mac copy, close the game and back up the complete working folder and its saves, settings and installed mods before replacing the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Select your own Nightmare Creatures II (USA) complete CHD (SLUS-01112, 2 tracks) and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove builds a private player and retains its declared saves, settings and installed mods. Bundled mods belong to the runtime version. Runtime rollback carries the current player data. Mac setup is upstream-owned.
